brief:
Israeli occupation forces conducted raids across several West Bank towns, the Shehab Wire reported, as a surge in settler attacks on Palestinian communities continues unabated. The military operations targeted multiple population centers in the territory, with no immediate reports of casualties or arrests disclosed.

The incursions took place against a backdrop of escalating violence by Israeli settlers against Palestinians in the West Bank. Settler assaults have intensified in recent weeks, adding to tensions in the occupied territory. Israeli forces have maintained an elevated operational tempo in Palestinian areas, conducting periodic raids and checkpoint operations across the region.
